components.name: Original acquisition work
components.rule: No numeric quote selected; preserve existing identity acquisition/validation/correlation coverage.

components.name: Original acquisition cleanup
components.retained_coverage: Retirement of up to13 owned slots,10 path backing slots,actual claims/errors and final carrier on unissued-scope complete route
components.rule: After scope sticky return happens before any of these effects; do not count child destruction as this completion.

components.name: Original acquisition storage
components.retained_coverage: Owned input bodies/path backings/claims/original errors,acquisition caller/result/refusal overlap and policy capacities
components.rule: Full charge remains after any scope issue,including unused/refused/dropped/forgotten results.

components.name: Preexisting parent allocation
components.retained_coverage: Root policy/account/quote variables,immutable paths/claims/identity preimages,outer caller/control/result/observation,scope pair,late destroy/token/release args/return bookkeeping
components.rule: No child-grant borrowing; standalone token and parent physical storage remain missing.

components.name: P1 setup
components.retained_coverage: Five setup attempts/partial prefix/original io errors;create_new outputs;all setup ownership retained
components.rule: No retry or truncate;refusal retains original prefix;P5 destruction coverage must rebind existing term,not duplicate.

components.name: P1 loader
components.retained_coverage: Actual loader/read/hash/provenance/source and separately priced original validation;complete selected/failure/File results and root-aware correlation/facade transfers
components.rule: Original validator separate from product VM budget;retain current callee evidence and backing limits. Do not duplicate original acquisition admission correlation debit.

components.name: P2 arguments
components.retained_coverage: FixtureLeafArguments rows/snapshot/cancellation/claims/budget/Instant and post-reservation fixture/attempt/expected closure argument/capture construction/transfers
components.rule: Proposed incremental assignment;contained fields/moves do not mint new backing or erase old quote terms. Quote/reserve work before commit stays P0.

components.name: P3 pre-store shell
components.retained_coverage: Current authentic adoption/scope/shell caller/control/borrow/return setup before selected route
components.rule: Keep existing dependencies and generic File/stdlib interfaces;no pointer-only substitution.

components.name: P4 selected route
components.retained_coverage: One relocated fixed scope/construct/outer/finish sequence with retained original VM/product/callee work and new root-bound envelopes
components.rule: Do not add old helper plus fixed frame as two leaf invocations;do not borrow product limits to fund host work.

components.name: P5 originals and destruction
components.retained_coverage: Complete setup or loaded payload/original diagnostics and File/proof/error/cancellation/claims retention;normal and cleanup/drop work through full child destruction
components.rule: Parent token/release frame stays P0;ordinary Drop/unwind returns no refund;File Drop is not healthy-close evidence.

existing_child_quote_rule: Exactly six positive work/storage CostV1 components;checked sums in ReviewedWholeQuoteV1::checked_components_v1. Preserve this source until a reviewed pricing amendment;model does not replace it with global peak.
forbidden_deductions: existing overlapping conservative terms silently discarded

incremental_assignment_proposal.C0: Root accessor before setup and root-bearing setup-refusal construction,plus existing setup work.
incremental_assignment_proposal.C1: New root-aware correlation/complete File facade and selected/refusal envelope transfers,plus existing loader/validation once.
incremental_assignment_proposal.C2: Post-reservation actual closure capture/argument construction and FixtureLeafArguments production/transfers.
incremental_assignment_proposal.C3: Existing pre-store adoption/shell call contexts,rebinding changed arguments/returns without duplicate callee work.
incremental_assignment_proposal.C4: One fixed consuming leaf sequence and its new branch/final envelopes;old helper relocation is not another leaf.
incremental_assignment_proposal.C5: Complete returned payload/owner retention and destruction,including new admitted nested-root shapes and normal/unwind drops.
incremental_assignment_proposal.P0: Scope pair/sticky-issue caller work before child reserve;quote/account/reserve bookkeeping;late destroy caller,token,release,outer scalar bookkeeping.
incremental_assignment_proposal.physical_attribution_gate: These are proposed work/ownership coverage labels,not proof that caller/return/token regions are disjoint. Before prices,choose one physical charge owner for every extent and explicitly reconcile existing P0/C5 return-carrier coverage;do not charge complete nested aggregates twice.

required_model_output: Coverage assessment against every retained term plus missing-evidence list;no numeric work price or storage grant.
